validated_results.title: Ingested Nitrate, Disinfection By-products, and Kidney Cancer Risk in Older Women.
validated_results.reason: This prospective cohort study evaluated dietary nitrite from processed meat and incident kidney cancer risk with multivariable-adjusted hazard ratios.

sample_size.excerpt: Hazard ratios (HR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) for kidney cancer associations with dietary nitrate and nitrite in the Iowa Women’s Health Study (N=33,964 a ) Cases

effect_size.excerpt: 31 We observed no association between dietary nitrate intake and kidney cancer risk, or for dietary nitrite overall ( Table 3 ). However, a higher risk was evident for the 95 th percentile of dietary nitrite from processed meats (HR p95vs.Q1 =1.8,95%CI:1.1–3.0; p trend =0.54).

confidence_interval.excerpt: However, a higher risk was evident for the 95 th percentile of dietary nitrite from processed meats (HR p95vs.Q1 =1.8,95%CI:1.1–3.0; p trend =0.54).
